grounding.quote:
name: refresh
description: Reload one explicitly selected STDO registry entry into context
argument-hint: "(--installed | --release <product-local-cut> | --candidate) [--doc <name>] [--list]"
disable-model-invocation: true

Claude invocation is `/spec:refresh`. This adapter adds no procedure or
authority and remains manual-only because a full registry entry materially
expands context.

concepts.label: Claude refresh adapter
concepts.definition: The Claude refresh adapter is named refresh, invokes as /spec:refresh, and reloads one explicitly selected STDO registry entry. Its argument interface is (--installed | --release <product-local-cut> | --candidate) [--doc <name>] [--list]. Model invocation is disabled.

grounding.quote:
Use this read-only procedure before every STDO workflow skill. It selects and
verifies one Product basis; it grants no mutation, execution, review,
disposition, installation, or continuation authority.

concepts.label: Product Basis Selection
concepts.definition: Product Basis Selection is a read-only procedure preceding every STDO workflow skill. It selects and verifies one Product basis and grants no mutation, execution, review, disposition, installation or continuation authority.

grounding.quote:
After the selected basis has verified, resolve each required member through
that same immutable basis. A route consists of the member's package-relative
path and, where needed, a heading anchor within it.

concepts.label: Verified member acquisition
concepts.definition: Member acquisition resolves a package-relative member path and, where needed, its heading anchor through the same immutable basis. Membership, bytes, installation location and anchors are checked independently of semantic fidelity and task sufficiency.

grounding.quote:
Reload one complete registry entry from exactly one selected STDO basis. An
entry is a declared bundle, owning member or task frame of this method. This is a read-only context
projection; it does not create a partial constitution.

concepts.label: STDO Refresh Procedure
concepts.definition: Refresh is a read-only context projection reloading one complete registry entry from exactly one selected STDO basis. An entry is a declared bundle, owning member or task frame; projection creates no partial constitution.

concepts.label: Review result domain
concepts.definition: The review projection names five core result values: satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis. They remain distinct from technical triage and Product disposition.

grounding.quote:
It uses
the objects of [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology), the core result
algebra of [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), and the frame
object and the outcomes of `activate` of
[REFERENCE_FRAME](REFERENCE_FRAME.md) (§5). It defines the step-level
concepts it introduces, among them the current state, the destination,
the transition, the configuration, the execution unit, acquisition, the
rewrite step, the licensing law, the adequacy relation, the work state,
the actor's account, progress and churn, proportionality and the closed
result, and refines the
core for admission, activation and steps (§3); it redefines nothing those
members own.

concepts.label: ACTIVATION standard
concepts.definition: ACTIVATION declares itself Tier 1 owner of bounded work: steps and their transitions, intake, execution unit, admission, applicability/exclusion, output, configuration and delegation; context construction, size/fit/acquisition/activation/evaluation/staleness; refined results and disposition; totality, refinement, hard stops, licensing and approximation; work state/restart/accounts; cost, proportionality and resource limits; and closed results, invalidation and reuse. It uses, without redefining, FOUNDATIONS objects and core results and REFERENCE_FRAME frame objects and activate outcomes.

grounding.quote:
A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active
frame configuration, on an exact subject (REFERENCE_FRAME §1, §11). Its
context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus
or the workspace is never the context (P0; RF-002). Intake, admission,
applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even
when one invocation performs all of them.

concepts.label: Bounded step
concepts.definition: A step activates one reference frame or declared active frame configuration on an exact subject. Its context is the activated frame's projection to the actor, never the corpus or workspace. Intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct even within one invocation.

grounding.quote:
The current state is the material state of the workspace and
its authoritative inputs, together with what is justifiably known about
that state, with the unknowns explicit. The work state of §5 records it:
the workspace, the governing basis, and the closed results and judgments
that still apply, with the residuals and the uncertainty over external
effects as the explicit unknowns. An actor's context is an account of the
current state, not the state itself
([§5](#the-workspace-and-an-actors-account)) (P3, P5).

concepts.label: Current state
concepts.definition: Current state comprises material workspace state, authoritative inputs, justified knowledge and explicit unknowns. Work state records the workspace, governing basis, still-applicable closed results and judgments, residuals and external-effect uncertainty. An actor's context is an account of this state, not the state.

grounding.quote:
The destination is defined by constraints: the selected outcome with its
acceptance conditions (Outcome U, [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology))
and the governing obligations the work must keep. It names no single
state: its acceptance conditions admit several realised states. Its
owning authority defines it (P2, P6).

concepts.label: Destination
concepts.definition: The destination is the owning authority's constraint-defined selected outcome, acceptance conditions and obligations to preserve. It admits multiple realised states rather than naming one state. Construction denotes this destination by Z.

grounding.quote:
A transition is a bounded change from the current state to a next state,
carried out by one step. Where the work exceeds one activation's capacity,
the outer transformation towards the destination is refined into a series
of bounded transitions under §4 Refinement, each carried out by its own
step; work that fits one activation is a single transition.

concepts.label: Bounded transition
concepts.definition: A transition is one step's bounded change from current to next state. Work fitting one activation is one transition; work exceeding it is refined into bounded transitions under the declared refinement law.

grounding.quote:
This subsection states the construction relation for this corpus: how a
selected construction binds its current state and destination, chooses
its work, composes its steps, corrects itself and claims completion. This
section owns that relation. ACTIVATION §2 to §7, EVALUATION §1,
SPEC_METHOD §4 and §8, EXECUTIVE_BASELINE and ODD apply it through their
local bindings; none creates a competing determination (P6).

concepts.label: Construction relation
concepts.definition: The construction relation binds current state A and destination predicate Z, selects work, composes steps, corrects discrepancies and grounds completion claims. Its three subject accounts are specification of required conditions, observations of what holds, and causal/predictive explanation of possible action effects. Strategy arranges admissible construction and assurance within resources; a composition boundary passes one step's output into the next starting state and differs from a categorical join. Feedback observes, compares, diagnoses, selects an authorized response, acts and observes again; homeostasis is correction toward required conditions without a convergence or adequacy guarantee.

grounding.quote:
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing
relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory
(P0, actor-change premise). The intake names:

concepts.label: Step intake
concepts.definition: Intake is the reconstructable governing basis from which a step activates, independent of conversation history, commentary or prior-actor memory.

grounding.quote:
The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone capable
of delivering working behaviour while preserving every affected governing
relation. It need not coincide with one function, file, module, ticket
field or design document (P0, P4b). A seam whose far side can causally affect,
or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis
establishes that it cannot participate. Unrelated incompleteness outside
the cone is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded
claim. The cone is the seed set Z of §2; the context is its projection.

concepts.label: Execution unit
concepts.definition: The execution unit is the smallest coherent causal dependency cone able to deliver working behaviour while preserving every affected governing relation. It need not align with a function, file, module, ticket field or design document. It is the seed set called Z for context construction in ACTIVATION §2, distinct in usage from construction's destination predicate Z.

grounding.quote:
Drafting a step's contract and admitting it are distinct relations, even
inside one invocation that drafts, validates, admits and executes; no
separate turn, carrier or approval ceremony is implied by the distinction.
A contract carries at minimum the states drafted, admitted, rejected and
superseded ([TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#execution-contract-admission)).

concepts.label: Execution-contract admission
concepts.definition: Execution-contract drafting and admission are distinct relations. Contracts carry at least drafted, admitted, rejected and superseded states. Admission validates a contract against its cited outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis; it does not admit that underlying basis.

relations.meaning: The adapter's described behavior is wholly supplied by REFRESH.md; the adapter adds no procedure or authority. Governing denotes the source's procedural dependency only.

that same immutable basis. A route consists of the member's package-relative

relations.meaning: Verified Product selection is a prerequisite for resolving required members from that same immutable basis; it supplies no additional effect authority.

grounding.quote:
A transition is a bounded change from the current state to a next state,
carried out by one step.

relations.meaning: One step carries out a bounded transition; this descriptive link does not itself admit the step.

grounding.quote:
Each
transition binds the obligations it must preserve: the outer obligations
of the destination and of the governing relations it affects, as far as
they apply to it.

relations.meaning: A transition must bind and preserve applicable outer destination obligations, together with affected governing-relation obligations.
conditions: The destination's obligations apply to the transition.

grounding.quote:
Binding A and Z. A construction binds A, the current state of Transitions
above with its account, and Z, the destination as a predicate over
realised states that includes the acceptance conditions of the selected
outcome. The account of A describes the material workspace state, the
relevant external observations acquired through the interfaces that own
them, what is justifiably known and the explicit unknowns; an actor's
acquired account can be incomplete or stale, and the workspace, not the
account, is the subject (§5).

relations.meaning: Construction binds actual current state A and its fallible account without replacing the workspace subject with the account.

grounding.quote:
Binding A and Z. A construction binds A, the current state of Transitions
above with its account, and Z, the destination as a predicate over
realised states that includes the acceptance conditions of the selected
outcome.

relations.meaning: Construction binds the outcome predicate Z with acceptance conditions; calculus lawfulness cannot select or establish that outcome.

grounding.quote:
Only an admitted contract activates a step: no
result, child completion, tool output, model response, shared actor or
lateral handoff activates another step or authorises continuation by
itself, and a profile that routes results names its instances of this
rule.

relations.meaning: Admitted contract is necessary for step activation; routing, returned results or shared actors alone cannot activate or authorize continuation.
conditions: An exact contract is admitted under the stated admission law.

grounding.quote:
Zero definitions, multiple applicable definitions, failed verification, or any
identity, path, basis, manifest, installation, or validity mismatch stops the
calling skill before effects. Report the exact candidates or mismatch and the
required re-entry; do not repair it implicitly.

constraints.statement: State requested scope from the exact request and Product identities/claims; insufficient distinction leaves scope unresolved. Discover candidate definitions only within the authorized workspace search boundary. Filename/current directory/nearest file/nesting are discovery only, not selection or composition. Determine applicability from definition identity and owned what/how/ticketing/bounded-context/explicit-composition bindings; paths select only when explicitly scope-bound. Require exactly one: zero returns unresolved scope, multiple returns every remaining identity/path and requests disambiguation; never choose by proximity, familiarity, recency or label. Read-only status verification must report matching definition identity/path, immutable basis URI and manifest SHA-256, installed:true, valid:true and no failures. Do not sync/adopt/install, substitute mutable source or nearby Product. Return scope, identity/path, URI/cut, digest and result; only then may caller continue under its own authority/effect boundary. Any listed mismatch stops before effects and reports exact candidates/mismatch and re-entry without implicit repair.

grounding.quote:
Resolve the member without its fragment, then locate the exact anchor in
those verified bytes; for example, `#7-closed-result-and-reuse` selects
ACTIVATION's reuse owner. A missing member, anchor, manifest mismatch or
content mismatch leaves the route unresolved. Acquire no replacement from a
checkout, moving selector, later cut or neighbouring Product. A frame is a
member too: verify its own bytes and the local sources and section digests
listed in `standards/frames/FRAME_INPUTS.json` before treating it as current.
This identity check does not establish semantic fidelity or task sufficiency.

constraints.statement: Use the verified definition's basis URI and manifest matching manifest_sha256. Require ACTIVATION.md in standards inventory and its resolved SHA-256 equal to the declared member digest; apply equivalent checks to every selected member. Returned URI must equal requested URI and path lie in the verified installation; path alone proves neither membership nor bytes. Resolve without fragment, then find exact anchor in verified bytes. Missing member/anchor or digest/content mismatch leaves the route unresolved; no checkout, moving-selector, later-cut or neighboring-Product replacement. For frames also verify local sources/section digests in FRAME_INPUTS.json before currency claims. Identity checking proves neither fidelity nor sufficiency. Return exact basis URI/manifest digest, member digest, selected anchor and unresolved dependencies for every acquired member; caller keeps its authority/effect boundary.

grounding.quote:
Each bundle loads its listed members in order. Owner and task entries
select narrower acquisition without changing the complete selected basis. A member listed without sections
loads in full. A listed section loads in full with all its subsections, up
to the next heading at its own level or shallower.

Task frames own no determination. Check their current source bindings and
acquire missing deciding owner sections under ACTIVATION §2; do not treat a
route as proof that the frame is sufficient for every task.

constraints.statement: Load listed bundle members in order; unsectioned members in full and selected sections in full including subsections until the next heading of equal or shallower level. Narrower owner/task acquisition does not change the complete basis. Accept owner names only from verified standards inventory; the method entry locates scope. Select a task entry when sufficient because full-owner reads have cost. Task frames own no determination: check source currency and acquire missing deciding sections under ACTIVATION §2; route availability proves no universal sufficiency.

constraints.statement: Resolve exactly one basis: installed requires one definition and verified URI/manifest; release resolves product-local cut via manager with possibly project-qualified Git transport and no moving-selector substitution. Candidate emits '[CANDIDATE] Mutable STDO authoring source loaded. This is not released consumer law.' Conclude with the stated Active context message retaining complete-basis constitutional authority, read subject to candidate's explicit non-operative status. Multiple explicit calls may build multi-document context; daily skills should normally read the smallest relevant surface.

exceptions: Explicit candidate mode uses the explicitly selected package and carries no released-consumer standing.

grounding.quote:
When construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker, the
method governs the execution relation without prescribing the worker's
model, prompt, tools, internal search, process topology, repository layout
or orchestration runtime (P0; the work boundary of FOUNDATIONS §2). The
normative relation runs: accepted governing basis; bounded affected
relation set; selected computational relations; delegated execution and
decision authority; construction and self-review; independent live-surface
assessment where required; one of accept, local repair, re-enter or reject
(§3); the exact accepted checkpoint; the next already-authorised bounded
action (§5).

constraints.statement: Govern the relation accepted basis → bounded affected relations → selected computational relations → delegated execution/decision authority → construction/self-review → independent live-surface assessment where required → accept/local repair/re-enter/reject → exact accepted checkpoint → next already-authorised bounded action. This does not prescribe worker model, prompt, tools, search, topology, layout or runtime.
conditions: Construction is delegated to a probabilistic or agentic worker.

grounding.quote:
Stops. Work that cannot continue ends in an explicit stop that names its
cause: a step that cannot deliver its output stops with a value of
construction availability other than `candidate_ready`, and a declared
ambiguity that halts the work or exceeds the step's authority stops it
with `blocked` or `escalated` (§3). A refused admission or activation
stops the work without creating a step (§3 Admission and activation).
The work state (§5) retains the unresolved outcome, the residuals and the
obligations still owed. A stop reaches no destination and discards none
of these (P4b, P5).

constraints.statement: Each transition binds applicable destination/affected-relation obligations; intake binds destination or prerequisite, exact state subject/basis, affected relation set/invariants. Composition is permitted only by §4 Refinement. Discovery may add obligations or invalidate claims; reestablish or withdraw invalid claims before reliance. Work outside attention stays open with material dependencies. Destination revision requires owning authority/re-entry and proves nothing about the prior destination. Completion requires sufficient evidence that current state meets applicable destination/acceptance; acceptance is decision-owner disposition. Empty worklists, counts and absent recorded counterexamples are insufficient. Unable-to-deliver steps stop with non-candidate_ready availability; halting or over-authority ambiguity yields blocked or escalated; refused admission/activation creates no step. Every stop names cause and retains unresolved outcome, residuals and obligations, reaching no destination. Progress is outcome/evidence-relative, not item count; discovery can increase work while progress occurs. Existing intake/work-state carriers suffice.
constraints.uncertainty: The complete availability and ambiguity algebras are deferred to unsupplied §3.

grounding.quote:
The applicable declared requirements and the declared calculi of the
tenant's binding ([SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding))
govern which transformations and compositions are lawful; the calculi
select no outcome. A
lawful construction can remain incomplete or fail to reach Z, and
lawfulness establishes neither delivery nor optimality. A proof about the
outcome that rests on premises retains those premises and its scope. A
selected construction may need to discover its path while performing and
evaluating work (P2, P3, P6).

constraints.statement: Bind A to actual workspace and its acquired account, external observations through owning interfaces, justified knowledge and unknowns; account may be stale/incomplete and is not the subject. Bind Z to the owning Product's governing WHAT across Intent/Product/Specification, with descriptions refining it and multiple realizations possible. Declared requirements/calculi govern lawful transformations/compositions but choose no outcome; lawful construction may fail or remain incomplete and proves neither delivery nor optimality. Premise-based proof retains premises/scope; paths may be discovered during work. Keep required conditions, observations and predictive models distinct: none establishes another, and model applicability/adequacy needs its own claim. Strategy serves Z within resources including context/attention/time/effort/computation/communication, feedback delay, uncertainty, integration and rework; planning/checking/coordination also cost. Measures state units/boundaries/composition and distinguish estimates/assumptions/observations. Incomparable objectives use owning tradeoff criteria. Granted actor/realization selects strategy with material rationale in existing records; superiority claims state objectives/comparison/assumptions. Context limits holding, attention limits use, frame selects step material/contract, and destination stays Z across activations.

grounding.quote:
Diagnosis distinguishes four causes: a defective realisation, an
inadequate governing requirement or design, an inaccurate predictive
model, and insufficient observation. A prediction error alone does not
decide whether the required outcome holds. A revised model does not erase
the counterexample or by itself repair the realisation. Diagnosis preserves unresolved
alternatives and routes each supported repair to the owner of its cause;
the intake label supplies no repair class and no permission. Severity
describes consequence; priority orders the response under the selected
outcome, dependencies, resources and authority. A bug list projects
existing work state and creates no separate delivery or authority
mechanism (P1, P2, P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Compose only compatible preconditions/effects/results/authority, preserving applicable outer obligations across decomposition/delegation/concurrency/recursion. Local success establishes end-to-end success only with coverage, compatibility and outcome evidence; chain obligations/categorical demonstrations retain FOUNDATIONS §4 ownership. Feedback follows observation/comparison/diagnosis/authorized response/action/reobservation; bugs use ordinary change intake/delivery. Diagnose defective realization, inadequate requirement/design, inaccurate model or insufficient observation separately; prediction error proves no outcome, model revision erases no counterexample and repairs no realization by itself. Preserve unresolved alternatives; supported repair belongs to cause owner, labels grant no class/permission. Severity concerns consequence, priority orders under outcome/dependencies/resources/authority; bug lists create no separate mechanism. Preservation, evidence-based progress, termination and outcome satisfaction require distinct support; formal induction/termination claims give premises/argument but no universal termination proof is prerequisite to bounded work. Continuing work needs supported purpose, possibly uncertainty reduction/hypothesis testing; repetition alone is not progress. Failure/missing information/uncertain effects/exhaustion use owned continuation/repair/recovery/re-entry/yield/stop; resume reacquires reality, preserves valid progress and resolves effects sufficiently before dependent action. Maintenance may continue under mandate; delivery needs completion conditions. Core evaluation preserves failure, coverage gaps and uncertainty; proof/checking/testing/use establish only scoped claims and required unavailable proof remains owed. Candidate, property proof and accepted delivery are separate. Completion needs sufficient Z evidence; exhaustion proves neither achievement nor impossibility, and changing Z leaves former counterexamples intact. Existing carriers suffice; relation adds no ledger, role sequence, runtime, general solver, fixed organization, convergence guarantee or categorical-universality theorem. Domain strategy/configuration/mechanisms/additional assurance retain their owners.

Intake names governed selected outcome/admitted prerequisite/experiment; exact workspace subject/basis and acquirable inputs by identity/hash or input commit; evaluation/family and core or core-mapped result algebra; bounded affected relations/invariants; accepted transformation-admission relations; computational/common-library machinery and bindings; frame-set, semantic, evaluation, material operation and decision authorities with permitted operations, mutable territory and reserved decisions; actor envelopes; staleness/out-of-scope/owner-re-entry conditions; and applicable cost allowance/measurement. Implementation folklore is not a source. Where design profile applies, its conservation/admission-completeness/reconstruction/computational-projection laws supply affected set, admission relations, invariants and dispositions; intake consumes these without creating another design package.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced authority kinds, design laws and result refinements are not fully supplied.
exceptions: Cost allowance and spend measurement are required where the governed question is a cost claim.

grounding.quote:
A seam whose far side can causally affect,
or be affected by, the action is inside the cone unless the basis
establishes that it cannot participate. Unrelated incompleteness outside
the cone is recorded as repricing input and does not block the bounded
claim. The cone is the seed set Z of §2; the context is its projection.

constraints.statement: Include both sides of any seam able to affect or be affected by the action unless basis establishes nonparticipation. Record unrelated incompleteness outside the cone as repricing input without blocking the bounded claim. Context is a projection of this cone.
exceptions: A causally relevant seam may be excluded only when the basis establishes it cannot participate.

grounding.quote:
The admitted contract names one
durable result and evidence surface; every result, withheld closure and
residual obligation is recorded there before return, a conversation return
alone is not durable evidence, and if no such surface is authorised and
available, admission refuses (P4b). Absent or rejected admission returns
the missing work authority without execution, as `admission_refused` with
its cause ([§3 Admission and activation](#admission-and-activation)).

constraints.statement: Execution begins only after deterministic admission or explicit exact-contract human override. Drafts, carriers, lanes and active labels cannot self-certify it. Admitted results identify mechanism/authority, exact contract identity/digest, decision/evidence including override; absent coordinates leave drafted or rejected, and prose is insufficient. Admission validates against but does not admit its cited basis. Drafting/admitting/retaining creates or renews no unadmitted authority. Only admitted contracts activate steps; results, child completion, tool/model outputs, shared actors and lateral handoffs alone activate nothing and authorize no continuation. No separate turn/carrier/approval ceremony is implied. Name one available authorized durable result/evidence surface and record every result, withheld closure and residual obligation before return; chat alone is insufficient and absent surface refuses admission. Missing/rejected admission returns admission_refused with cause and missing work authority without execution. TICKETS §5 owns carrier choice.
exceptions: An explicit human override of the exact contract is an alternative to deterministic admission.

grounding.quote:
Steel thread, phased (waterfall) delivery and iterative delivery are
possible strategies, each with its own costs, feedback delays, integration risks and rework.
The selection belongs to the realisation and to the actor exercising the
admitted work authority; its material rationale is stated in existing
design or work records, and a claim that one strategy is superior states
the objectives, comparison and assumptions it depends on. No exhaustive
optimisation, universal numerical budget, scalar cost measure or preferred
strategy is imposed by this relation or its consumers (P2, P5, P6).

independent actions may
proceed concurrently where their dependencies, effects and authority
permit. Local success supplies end-to-end success only when the required
coverage, composition compatibility and outcome evidence hold;

A formal induction or
termination claim supplies its premises and argument; no universal
termination proof is required before bounded work can begin, and where
such a proof is absent the claim stays within the available evidence.

allowed: Select steel-thread, phased/waterfall, iterative or other admissible strategies under owning criteria and admitted work authority.
Proceed concurrently with independent actions where dependencies, effects and authority permit.
Begin bounded work without a universal termination proof while limiting claims to available evidence.
forbidden: Claim strategy superiority without objectives, comparison and assumptions.
Impose exhaustive optimization, a universal numerical budget, scalar cost measure or preferred strategy as a requirement of this relation or its consumers.
Infer end-to-end success solely from local success.
